tasks.title: Census public operations and semantic model families
tasks.goal: Create an exact whole-product denominator for external access before designing protocol wrappers.
steps: Enumerate every public CLI/subcommand/TUI semantic action and MCP registration, then trace its owning library, effects and existing structured carriers.
Enumerate resolver/compiler/trace/lifecycle/receipt/tree/cache/settings/registry/bin/refactor models and all planned M-01 through M-15 operation families; distinguish presentation-only state.
Create a proposed versioned CapabilityCoverage inventory with stable IDs, owner/schema/source/target/effect/authority/completeness/retention/test columns and explicit unimplemented rows.
positive_cases: Every discovered registration/model family maps to a stable coverage row.
Legacy administrative and source-conversion operations remain visible.
negative_cases: MCP's tool list is treated as the whole product census.
Matching name counts without an executable path is marked covered.
checks: SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: vibe-cli target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p vibe-cli <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: vibe-mcp target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p vibe-mcp <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.
TO CREATE: registration-to-coverage denominator check in xtask; exact command grammar must be created and verified before use.
acceptance: No identified command/action/model lacks a disposition and domain owner.
The register is interface coverage only, not a requirements engine or scheduler.
tasks.safe_stop: Census and observed gaps are complete against the inspected baseline; no runtime behavior changes.

notes: Planned permanent destination: vibevm/vibespecs/common/PROP-067-machine-operations-and-observability.xml, reconciled with existing PROP-018/031/032/036/054; forward metadata only.
formats/capability-coverage/ and docs/machine-api/ are proposed permanent homes; locate integration in existing registry conventions before creating files.

Bind the smallest affected target and exact cases before compiling. Discover from source/metadata, then list only the bound target/case and require a nonzero match. Add broader checks only for demonstrated affected behavior that the selected checks cannot establish.

tasks.title: Map domain authority and ETO compatibility boundaries
tasks.goal: Specify extraction seams and complete semantic observability without a new universal graph engine or IDE product.
steps: For each coverage family identify retained authoritative records, currently CLI-local logic, reusable library seams and missing inspection surfaces.
Reconcile PROP-032/031 proposals with actual commands and define semantic/debug schema epochs, redaction/unavailable reasons and applicability versus implementation-gap states.
Record transport-neutral discovery/capture/query/prepare/admit/submit/observe/recover flow and per-domain closure requirements; leave LSP/DAP/client adapters, plugins and MVP out.
positive_cases: Every semantic view links to its owning domain and a proposed executable conformance case.
Debug schemas can evolve independently while retained data remains interpretable.
negative_cases: Private debug memory is exposed as a stable ABI.
A supported feature's missing API is disguised as contextual unsupported.
checks: CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- check --path . --quiet only when actual spec/boot/dependency composition impact requires whole-project validation. Otherwise bind an existing appropriate root or focused declared-source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.
TO CREATE: coverage model/owner/reference consistency check, separate from semantic review.
acceptance: All D-025/D-026 obligations are assigned without replacing resolver/compiler/journals.
The design identifies exact source families for downstream M-16/M-17 work.
tasks.safe_stop: Reviewed authority/coverage map is ready for permanent specification promotion; no transport is implemented yet.
